issues.text: You walked ten thousand steps. Every day. For a year. That's like walking from London... all the way to Moscow.
issues.heard: you walk 10000 steps every day for a year that is like walking from london all the way to moscow

text: You walked ten thousand steps. Every day. For a year. That's like walking from London... all the way to Moscow. {deadpan} And the weighing scale? It barely moved. {soft} But something inside your head... grew.
